paragraphs.text: Mwonvuli Jungle (mwahn-VOO-lee ) sprawls across much of eastern Zhalfir .

From the base of the Ekunda and Teremko Mountains to the Daraja and Mtenda Plains , Mwonvuli is a lush and verdant forest where it constantly rains. Although it was taken over by dark spirits during the Mirage War , Mwonvuli returned to its feral but rather benign state. Across the deep forest stretched many fortresses and palaces of Jolrael , the so-called Empress of Beasts. It was also the location of the Amber Prison containing Mangara .

The jungle is crossed by the Mwonvuli River . The end of this river, the large Mwonvuli Delta , once was the meeting place of Mangara and Kaervek . The Mwonvuli River is fed by a great many rivers which sprang from the Talruum Mountains .
The Mwonvuli Jungle was phased out by Teferi during the Phyrexian Invasion , and now exists as part of the plane of Zhalfir .
The jungle's name is derived from mwavuli or mwamvuli , Swahili for "umbrella".
